title: Ordinary compatible boundaries from pure multiplication triangles
statement: In any abelian category A with a derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], fix a natural number ell, a complex P, a derived isomorphism Q(P) isomorphic to single(M)[1], and a tower H. Suppose short exact sequences P --ell^(n+1)--> P --q_n--> Q_n have compatible quotient maps t_n with q_(n+1)t_n=q_n. Suppose supplied pure identifications Q(Q_n) isomorphic to single(H_n)[2] respect t_n, and carry q_n to prescribed arrows v_n. Then there exist ordinary maps d_n:H_n to M for which (ell^(n+1),v_n,single(d_n)[2] followed by shift addition) is distinguished and H-transition followed by d_n equals d_(n+1) followed by ell.

source.place: Steps (2) and (3), the common two-term resolution and its (ell,1) transition.

proof.text: Take the short-exact-sequence connecting morphisms and transport them by the supplied isomorphisms. Full faithfulness of degree-zero single followed by shift two writes each connecting morphism uniquely as single(d_n)[2] followed by the shift-addition isomorphism.
Transport the distinguished short-exact-sequence triangle by these isomorphisms; the supplied quotient-arrow identity fixes the middle arrow and additivity fixes multiplication.

Form a morphism of short exact sequences with components (ell,identity,t_n). Naturality of the connecting morphism gives the boundary identity in the derived category. Scalar centrality through the shift-addition isomorphism and faithfulness of shifted single give the asserted ordinary identity.

theorem pure_multiplication_triangle_assembly
    {A : Type*} [Category A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    (ℓ : ℕ) (P : CochainComplex A ℤ) (M : A) (H : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A)
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj M)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (Q : ℕ → CochainComplex A ℤ) (q : ∀ n, P ⟶ Q n)
    (t : ∀ n, Q (n + 1) ⟶ Q n)
    (hz : ∀ n, (ℓ ^ (n + 1) • 𝟙 P) ≫ q n = 0)
    (hS : ∀ n, (ShortComplex.mk _ (q n) (hz n)).ShortExact)
    (ht : ∀ n, q (n + 1) ≫ t n = q n)
    (b : ∀ n, DerivedCategory.Q.obj (Q n) ≅
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj (H.obj (op n)))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hb : ∀ n, DerivedCategory.Q.map (t n) ≫ (b n).hom =
      (b (n + 1)).hom ≫
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).map
          (H.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧')
    (v : ∀ n, ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj M)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj (H.obj (op n)))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hv : ∀ n, DerivedCategory.Q.map (q n) ≫ (b n).hom = e.hom ≫ v n) :
    ∃ d : ∀ n, H.obj (op n) ⟶ M,
      (∀ n, Triangle.mk
        (ℓ ^ (n + 1) • 𝟙 (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj M)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧))
        (v n)
        (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).map (d n))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧' ≫
          (shiftFunctorAdd (DerivedCategory A) (1 : ℤ) 1).hom.app
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj M)) ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory A)) ∧
      ∀ n, H.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op ≫ d n = d (n + 1) ≫ (ℓ • 𝟙 M)
